tools.name: check_openapi
tools.description: Developer tool for OpenAPI audit, API analysis, Swagger analysis, and API contract change validation (not general OpenAPI conformance linting). The paid analysis detects breaking changes and API drift by comparing a public OpenAPI/Swagger JSON or YAML contract with the service's last stored snapshot

tools.name: compare_openapi
tools.description: Validates explicit before and after public OpenAPI/Swagger URLs and returns purchase terms for an immediate deterministic semantic comparison, including structural oneOf/anyOf branch changes. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_openapi · Private data: check_openapi · Public sink: check_openapi · Destructive: check_openapi.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_openapi · Private data: check_openapi · Public sink: check_openapi · Destructive: check_openapi

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_openapi" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
